en.headline: Security chief Chris Tang receives scam call impersonating bureau officer
en.dek: Tang challenged the caller to find him on the 10th floor of government headquarters after being told he had violated mainland laws and must report for identity checks.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on Thursday he received a telephone call from someone claiming to be a Security Bureau officer.

In a video posted on social media, Tang recounted that the caller alleged he had violated mainland laws and instructed him to report to the 10th floor of the government headquarters for identity verification.
Tang said he asked which section of the bureau the caller belonged to and told him he was already on the 10th floor, inviting the caller to come and find him there.

He stressed that the Security Bureau never calls members of the public to demand assistance with investigations or to request money transfers. Such calls impersonating government departments are attempts to obtain personal data or demand payments, he said.
Tang urged the public to stay vigilant and not fall for such scams.

zh.headline: 保安局局長鄧炳強接獲假冒保安局人員詐騙電話
zh.dek: 對方聲稱他涉嫌觸犯內地法律，要求到政府總部十樓核實身份，鄧炳強反邀對方親自到場找他。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周四表示，他接獲一通自稱是保安局人員的電話。
他在社交媒體上載短片稱，對方表示他涉嫌觸犯內地法律，並要求他到政府總部十樓核實身份。
鄧炳強說，他詢問對方屬於局內哪個部門，並告訴對方自己已在十樓，邀請對方親自前來找他。
他強調，保安局絕不會致電市民要求協助調查，更不會要求轉帳。假冒政府部門的來電，目的都是騙取個人資料或索取金錢。
鄧炳強呼籲市民保持警覺，切勿上當。
